notes.title: Royal Wars 0.9 is Live!
notes.notes:
[h3]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Royal Wars 0.9[/b] is out now![/h3][p][/p][p]This brings us one big step closer to the full release — and we couldn’t have done it without your continued support. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p]To ensure the best possible experience, we’ve taken a bit more time than planned, but we think this massive update was worth the wait.[/p][p][/p][h3] [i]Community Levels Are Here![/i][/h3][p]If you own the Supporters DLC, you now have access to map creation tools![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/269c9d4a6da52a0ac4f837cb681444e6b40b0d8f.png"][/img][/p][p]Design your own levels, upload them to the Steam Workshop, and share your creativity with the world.[/p][p] Don’t forget to share your best maps with us and the community — we love seeing what you build![/p][p][/p][h3] [i]New Heroes Have Arrived![/i][/h3][p]A new set of powerful heroes is now available to unlock in the game.[/p][h3]
[b][i]Glacior, Chilly Apprentice (Tier 3, 4, 5 )[/i][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/9eb619628391b8e1e4e9694ac2a6bb073d7630aa.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b][i]Sir Stompalot (Tier 5)[/i][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/9ed18eac72228538d862f33af141850c0898c951.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b][i]Dragoon ( Tier5 )[/i][/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/a95663448bc0e573af54fcd92fbf76eff5483c26.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3][b][i]Shadowmeld ( Tier5 )[/i][/b][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/db6d038392c3409125f6267886831f7e330244fa.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Experiment with new strategies and turn the tide of battle with these fresh faces!.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/d7d9dfa3ee0462c2f8acd521133723fe07252757.png"][/img] [b]What’s New[/b] [/p][p]Community Levels Workshop[/p][p]6 New Towers[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/560a402a7ac7a7f9178b692164b03bd6c2fd1062.png"][/img] [b]Improvements[/b][/p][p]Ingame Shop

notes.title: Exciting Updates: Deck Building, New UI, and More!
notes.notes:
[img][/img]Hello! [b]Royal Warrior's[/b] We value your feedback and are dedicated to creating the perfect game! We’re thrilled to introduce some updates, including Deck Building. Imagine crafting your own deck to defend and outsmart your opponents. This is just one of the many improvements we’re working on to enhance your gameplay experience! 🎮 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/65b4b347555ae601126261625729a9eaed01a396.png[/img]

That’s not all, folks! We’ve also been working hard to improve the UI, making it more user-friendly. Additionally, we’re introducing free tower placement, and crystals now play an additional new role, they grant buffs to enhance your strategy instead of using support towers. Are you ready for these exciting changes? 🕹️ 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/f98521463ddcd86f58e90868624d1e2fbbdecfc3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194050/8b22f4e29aa4fb358e471c73087cb4c5cfb7d1c0.png[/img]

Stay tuned for the next update! 🔥

notes.title: v0.0.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello royal warriors![/h2]
We welcome everyone that tried out our game after the early access release. Here are some patch notes for version 0.0.3:

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
Game Balancing: We’ve heard your feedback! Levels and enemy difficulty have been adjusted to ensure a more balanced and enjoyable experience. You'll find that gameplay is smoother and more engaging, making every play session more fun!

[h3]Visuals[/h3]
Halloween Theme: We’ve heard your feedback and enhanced the game’s atmosphere with spooky pumpkins and other props! Don’t be afraid! Our towers are here to protect you as you navigate through this festive, haunted experience!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Game Softlocks on completion screen upon completing a set stage with a tower's info up; the info stays up behind completion, esc pause is the only thing possible, but no buttons work otherwise. [b](@Lus75)[/b]
